definitions.explanation: The physical size or scale of something. Formed from the adjective 大きい by replacing い with さ.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大|おお}きさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧くらいです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大|おお}きさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The apples are each a different size.
The shoe size doesn't fit, so my feet hurt.

notes:
{大|おお}きさ means "size" or "magnitude" — the extent of how big something is.

FORMS:
Formed with the ～さ suffix that converts い-adjectives into nouns expressing degree:
- ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ → {大|おお}きさ (size)
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ → ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧ (height)
- ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ → ⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧ (length)
- ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ → ⟦{広|ひろ}さ→広さ：00105_hirosa⟧ (spaciousness)
- ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ → {小|ちい}ささ (smallness)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大|おお}きさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: to differ in size
- {大|おお}きさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧: to be the same size
- {大|おお}きさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure the size
- {大|おお}きさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比|くら}べる→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧: to compare sizes

USAGE:
Unlike English "size" which can also refer to clothing sizes (S/M/L), {大|おお}きさ primarily refers to physical dimensions. For clothing sizes, ⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧ is more common: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (Do you have this size?).
